title: Keepsake: Selective Spatial Memory for Long-Horizon Video Generation
title_zh: Keepsake：用于长时程视频生成的选择性空间记忆

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation relies on persistent memory to maintain scene consistency beyond the model’s immediate temporal context. Existing systems follow two strategies to achieve this consistency. Full-history approaches retain all generated observations, causing unbounded storage and retrieval costs to grow while allowing low-fidelity memories to persist. Selective-construction approaches reduce redundancy, but make one-time retention decisions that are never revisited, even as an observation’s value changes with the evolving memory bank. Both strategies leave a shared question unresolved: as the generated history evolves, which stored observations should still remain in memory? Our key insight is that the value of a stored observation is not fixed, but relational: it depends on the alternatives currently available in the memory bank. A view supported by many geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be relinquished with little loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should remain regardless of age. We introduce Keepsake , an online, training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory. At each update, Keepsake constructs a pose–appearance graph over retained and newly generated observations, combining camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. A retention priority jointly captures the number of strong substitutes and the similarity of the closest alternative, allowing Keepsake to continually reassess memory value, preserve observations with little alternative support, and evict highly replaceable ones under a fixed budget. The controller modifies only the persistent-memory update; the host generator, denoising schedule, and retrieval rule remain unchanged. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS under a fixed memory budget; on 180-second MemCam trajectories, it retains only 32 of 5,397 frames while reducing FVD by 35.1%.
paragraphs.zh: 长时段的摄像头控制视频生成依赖持久化记忆，以在模型即时时间上下文之外维持场景一致性。 现有系统采用两种策略来实现这种一致性。 全历史方法会保留所有生成的观察结果，导致存储和检索成本无限制增长，但允许低保真度的记忆持续存在。 选择性构建方法虽能减少冗余，却需要一次性做出且永不重审的保留决策，即便观察结果的价值会随着记忆库的演变而改变。 这两种策略都留下了一个共同未解的问题：随着生成历史不断演进，哪些已存储的观察结果仍应保留在记忆中？ 我们的核心洞见是：已存储观察结果的价值并非固定不变，而是具有关系性——它取决于当前记忆库中可用的替代项。 若某个视角有大量几何和视觉上相似的替代项支持，则即使放弃该视角也不会造成显著覆盖损失；而仅有少数可行替代项的观察结果，无论其存储时间多长都应保留。 我们提出了 Keepsake，一种针对固定容量空间记忆的在线、无需训练的控制器。 在每次更新时，Keepsake 会在已保留和新生成的观察结果之间构建一个姿态-外观图，结合摄像头姿态的邻近性与视觉相似性。 保留优先级同时考虑了强替代项的数量与最近替代项的相似性，使 Keepsake 能够持续重新评估记忆价值：保留缺乏替代支持的观察结果，并在固定预算下移除高度可替换的观察结果。 该控制器仅修改持久化记忆的更新过程；主机生成器、去噪调度与检索规则均保持不变。 在 MemCam 和 WorldMem 实验中，Keepsake 在固定记忆预算下提升了 FVD 和 LPIPS 指标；对于 180 秒的 MemCam 轨迹，它仅保留 5,397 帧中的 32 帧，同时将 FVD 降低了 35.1%。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controlled video generation enables deliberate viewpoint navigation within generated scenes, supporting interactive exploration and controllable content creation. Extending this capability to long horizons requires preserving scene consistency beyond the model’s immediate temporal context, particularly when previously observed regions are revisited after substantial temporal gaps. Recent memory-augmented methods address this challenge by maintaining historical observations associated with camera states, retrieving relevant evidence for subsequent generation, and writing newly generated observations back into persistent memory Gao et al. (2026) ; Xiao et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) . Each generation step is therefore both an output and a potential source of evidence for future generation.

paragraphs.en: Existing spatial-memory systems commonly retain the full generation history and rely on retrieval to select relevant observations at query time Gao et al. (2026) ; Xiao et al. (2026) . This strategy introduces two coupled limitations. First, the memory archive grows continuously with generation, leading to increasing retrieval overhead as the number of stored observations expands (Fig. 1 (a)). Second, quality degradation can persist in the memory archive, allowing drifted observations to be repeatedly retrieved and reused. As shown in Fig. 1 (b), memories with well-matched viewpoints can still deviate substantially from the established scene, indicating that geometric relevance alone does not guarantee reliable memory. Fig. 1 (c) further shows the resulting inconsistency when the camera revisits the same region, where the regenerated scene no longer matches its earlier appearance.

(2026) 。 这种策略带来了两个相互关联的局限性。 首先，记忆存档会随着生成过程持续增长，导致已存储的观察结果数量增加时，检索开销也随之增大（图 1 (a)）。 其次，记忆存档中的质量退化可能持续存在，使得发生偏移的观察结果被反复检索和重复使用。 如图 1 (b) 所示，即使视角匹配良好的记忆，也可能与已建立的场景产生显著偏差，这表明仅凭几何相关性无法保证记忆的可靠性。 图 1 (c) 进一步展示了当摄像头再次访问同一区域时所产生的不一致性：此时重新生成的场景已不再与其早期的外观相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Selective-construction approaches reduce redundant accumulation through spatial admission, keyframe selection, or memory merging Li et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2026) . However, these decisions are typically made only when an observation is written and are not revisited as the memory evolves. This is limiting because the value of a stored observation is inherently dynamic: a view that is unique at admission may later become redundant as similar evidence accumulates, while an older view with few substitutes may remain important. paragraphs.en: We formulate this as a dynamic reassessment problem. The retention value of an observation is relational rather than intrinsic, depending on the alternatives currently available in memory. A view with several geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be removed with limited loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should be retained regardless of its age or admission-time novelty. Selective forgetting therefore serves not only to bound memory growth, but also to continually reallocate capacity toward observations that remain most informative.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此问题表述为一个动态重新评估问题。 观测值的保留价值是关系性的而非内在的，它取决于当前记忆中可用的替代方案。 一个具有多个在几何和视觉上相似的替代项的视图，即使被移除也不会造成太大的覆盖损失；而一个仅有少数可行替代项的观测值，无论其年龄或进入时的新颖性如何，都应予以保留。 因此，选择性遗忘不仅有助于限制记忆的增长，还能持续地将容量重新分配给那些仍然最具信息价值的观测值。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Keepsake , an online, training-free, plug-and-play memory controller that dynamically reassesses which observations should remain in memory. At each update, Keepsake pools the retained memory with newly generated observations and constructs a pose–appearance graph whose edge weights combine camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. Each observation is scored by its number of strong substitutes and the similarity of its closest alternative. Low-priority observations, those with many strong substitutes are evicted until a fixed budget B B is satisfied. Crucially, retention priorities depend on the current candidate set rather than being fixed at admission, so an observation that was previously important can become replaceable as new alternatives arrive. The fixed budget bounds memory growth and retrieval overhead, while dynamic reassessment continually reallocates capacity toward observations that remain most useful.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Keepsake，这是一种在线、无需训练、即插即用的内存控制器，能够动态重新评估哪些观察结果应保留在内存中。 在每次更新时，Keepsake 会将保留的内存与新生成的观察结果合并，并构建一个姿态-外观图，其边权重结合了相机姿态的接近性与视觉相似性。 每个观察结果的得分取决于其强替代项的数量以及与其最接近替代项的相似性。 低优先级的观察结果（即拥有许多强替代项的观察结果）会被移除，直到满足固定的预算 B。 关键在于，保留优先级取决于当前的候选集，而非在接收时固定不变；因此，一个此前重要的观察结果，随着新替代项的出现可能变得可替换。 固定预算限制了内存的增长和检索开销，而动态重新评估则持续将容量重新分配给那些仍然最有用处的观察结果。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments show selective forgetting can improve generation quality while substantially reducing memory size. On fifteen matched 180-second MemCam Gao et al. (2026) trajectories, Keepsake retains only 32 observations instead of 5,397 while reducing FVD from 734.2 to 476.6, a 35.1% improvement. On fifteen matched 60-second WorldMem Xiao et al. (2026) videos, FVD decreases from 3077.6 to 1116.9. Importantly, simply imposing a memory cap is not sufficient: FIFO retention degrades generation quality relative to full retention, and different bounded policies yield substantially different results under the same budget (Tab. 1 ). These results show memory quality depends not only on how much history is retained, but also on which observations remain available.

paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify a fundamental limitation of growing spatial memory in camera-controlled long-horizon video generation and formulate retention as a dynamic reassessment problem: an observation’s value depends on the substitutes currently available in memory, rather than its age or admission-time novelty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出在相机控制的长时程视频生成中，空间记忆持续增长存在一个根本性限制，并将保留问题表述为一个动态重新评估问题：某个观察值的价值取决于当前记忆中可用的替代项，而非其年龄或进入时的新颖性。

paragraphs.en: We propose Keepsake , a training-free memory controller that continuously reassesses retention value through pose–appearance substitutability, preserving observations with few viable alternatives under a fixed budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Keepsake，这是一种无需训练的内存控制器，它通过姿态与外观的可替代性持续重新评估保留价值，在固定预算下保留那些仅有少数可行替代方案的观察结果。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on MemCam and WorldMem show that selective forgetting can simultaneously improve long-horizon generation quality and substantially reduce memory and retrieval cost, outperforming both full-history retention and bounded baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MemCam 和 WorldMem 上的实验表明，选择性遗忘能够同时提升长期生成质量，并显著降低记忆与检索成本，其表现优于完整历史保留和有限边界基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Recent text-to-video and image-to-video models have achieved impressive visual quality and realism Chen et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Blattmann et al. (2023) . However, they offer limited control over viewpoint evolution. Explicit camera control is therefore essential for applications that require deliberate viewpoint navigation and interactive exploration of a generated scene. Accordingly, recent studies directly condition video generation on camera trajectories Wang et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2024) ; Zheng et al. (2024) ; Hou and Chen (2024) . Yang et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) disentangle camera motion from object motion, while He et al. (2024) introduce explicit camera-pose conditioning into pretrained video generators. More recent work further improves camera controllability through geometric and correspondence priors, including epipolar constraints, trajectory-based correspondence, monocular depth, and explicit 3D scene representations Zheng et al. (2024) ; Hou and Chen (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2025) ; Li and others () ; Ren et al. (2025) . Building on camera-controllable video generation, Keepsake focuses on maintaining scene consistency over long horizons, particularly preserving previously observed content when the camera revisits earlier viewpoints after extended exploration.

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon camera exploration requires preserving scene information beyond the model’s local context, particularly when previously observed regions are revisited after large temporal or viewpoint gaps. paragraphs.en: Keepsake maintains a memory bank of at most B B observations by reassessing redundancy as new views arrive. The retention priority of an image depends on the alternatives currently available: how many views provide similar evidence, and how closely its strongest alternative matches it. We capture these relationships through a pose-appearance graph that combines camera geometry with visual similarity. At each update, the controller ranks retained and incoming images, favoring views with limited alternative support and removing low-priority observations to satisfy the budget. We pose memory retention as a prospective policy, as in interactive video world models, there is no certainty on where the camera will move next. paragraphs.en: We investigate how much spatial memory long-horizon generation needs and how that capacity should be allocated. Our primary comparisons use MemCam and WorldMem, varying memory retention while keeping the generator and retrieval rule unchanged within each system. Comparisons against complete retention test whether a compact memory bank can preserve generation quality; comparisons at matched budgets test whether the choice of retained observations matters.

sents.en: Comparisons against complete retention test whether a compact memory bank can preserve generation quality; comparisons at matched budgets test whether the choice of retained observations matters.
sents.zh: 与完全保留记忆的对比实验检验了紧凑型记忆库能否维持生成质量；在相同预算下的对比则检验了保留哪些观察结果是否会影响最终效果。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Keepsake in two settings: MemCam ( Gao et al., 2026 ) on the Context-as-Memory dataset ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , and WorldMem ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) on its Minecraft world-simulation dataset. Each primary evaluation contains fifteen matched 60-second videos. A separate set of fifteen matched 180-second MemCam videos also test longer generation. Within each system, retention policies share the initial inputs, prescribed control sequences, generator checkpoint, generation settings, and random seeds. We report comparisons separately for each system and duration, so that differences between retention policies are measured under the same generation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种设置下对 Keepsake 进行了评估：在 Context-as-Memory 数据集（Yu et al., 2025）上的 MemCam（Gao et al., 2026），以及在 Minecraft 世界模拟数据集上的 WorldMem（Xiao et al., 2026）。 每次主要评估均包含十五段匹配的 60 秒视频。 另外一组十五段匹配的 180 秒 MemCam 视频也用于测试更长时间的生成能力。 在每个系统内部，保留策略共享初始输入、预定的控制序列、生成器检查点、生成设置和随机种子。 我们分别针对每个系统和每种时长报告比较结果，以便在相同的生成条件下衡量不同保留策略之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: We compare Keepsake with complete retention and three bounded baselines: FIFO, K-center, and Marginal Coverage Eviction (MCE). FIFO prioritizes recency by discarding the oldest eligible observations. K-center selects representatives to improve worst-case coverage, while MCE removes observations whose deletion minimally reduces coverage over representative historical queries. Both coverage-based baselines use geometry and appearance, whereas Keepsake ranks observations by redundancy within the current candidate bank using node degree and maximum similarity. All bounded methods use the same archive budget, with B = 32 B=32 in the main comparison. Additional algorithmic details are provided in the appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Keepsake 与完全保留策略以及三种有界基线方法进行了比较：FIFO、K-center 和边际覆盖驱逐（MCE）。 FIFO 通过丢弃最旧的合格观测值来优先保留较新的观测值。 K-center 通过选择代表来改善最差情况下的覆盖范围，而 MCE 则移除那些删除后对代表性历史查询的覆盖范围影响最小的观测值。 这两种基于覆盖的基线方法都使用了几何信息和外观信息，而 Keepsake 则是根据当前候选库中节点度和最大相似性来对观测值的冗余程度进行排序。 所有有界方法都使用相同的存档预算，在主比较中 B = 32。 更多算法细节见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: We measure frame-level fidelity using LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , comparing generated frames with ground truth at the corresponding trajectory indices, and video-level distributional quality using FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) . Lower values indicate better performance for both metrics. We additionally evaluate six VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) dimensions: subject consistency, background consistency, motion smoothness, dynamic degree, aesthetic quality, and imaging quality. These dimensions characterize perceptual quality and temporal behavior; we report them individually on a × 100 \times 100 scale rather than constructing an aggregate score.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares complete retention with bounded-memory policies on the 60-second evaluation suites. With B = 32 B=32 , Keepsake improves both LPIPS and FVD over complete retention in both systems. In MemCam, LPIPS decreases from 0.5916 to 0.5850 and FVD from 784.9 to 690.5. In WorldMem, the corresponding improvements are 0.6523 to 0.5337 and 3077.6 to 1116.9. Among budget-matched policies, Keepsake achieves the lowest LPIPS in both systems and the lowest FVD in WorldMem. FIFO, in contrast, worsens both metrics relative to complete retention in both systems. These results show that compact memory can improve generation quality, but imposing a capacity limit alone is insufficient: different retention rules yield substantially different outcomes under the same budget.
paragraphs.zh: 表1比较了完整保留策略与有限记忆策略在60秒评估套件上的表现。 当 B = 32 时，Keepsake 在这两个系统中都比完整保留策略在 LPIPS 和 FVD 上表现更优。 在 MemCam 中，LPIPS 从 0.5916 降至 0.5850，FVD 从 784.9 降至 690.5。 在 WorldMem 中，对应的改进幅度为 LPIPS 从 0.6523 降至 0.5337，FVD 从 3077.6 降至 1116.9。 在预算匹配的策略中，Keepsake 在这两个系统中都实现了最低的 LPIPS，并在 WorldMem 中实现了最低的 FVD。 相比之下，FIFO 在这两个系统中相对于完整保留策略都使两项指标恶化。 这些结果表明，紧凑的记忆结构可以提升生成质量，但仅施加容量限制是不够的：在相同预算下，不同的保留规则会产生显著不同的结果。

paragraphs.en: We also evaluate Keepsake using MemCam’s original camera round-trip protocol on Context-as-Memory ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , covering 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} (153-frame) and 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} (609-frame) trajectories. We include Diffusion Forcing(DFoT) model Song et al. (2025) and Geometry Forcing Wu et al. (2026) in the comparison as well. As shown in Table 2 , Keepsake remains competitive with a memory budget of B = 32 B=32 , achieving higher SSIM and lower LPIPS than MemCam in both settings. On the 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} round trip, PSNR also increases from 14.81 to 16.22 dB.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还使用 MemCam 的原始相机往返协议，在“上下文即记忆”（Yu et al., 2025）框架下对 Keepsake 进行了评估，涵盖 90 ∘ 90^{\circ}（153 帧）和 360 ∘ 360^{\circ}（609 帧）的轨迹。此外，我们还将 Diffusion Forcing（DFoT）模型（Song et al., 2025）和 Geometry Forcing（Wu et al., 2026）纳入比较。如表 2 所示，在记忆预算为 B = 32 的情况下，Keepsake 仍然具有竞争力，在这两种设置下均实现了比 MemCam 更高的 SSIM 和更低的 LPIPS。在 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} 的往返测试中，PSNR 也从 14.81 提升至 16.22 dB。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate fifteen matched 180-second MemCam trajectories to test bounded retention over a longer generation horizon, keeping the memory budget fixed at B = 32 B=32 . Figure 3(a) reports this evaluation separately from the 60-second suite. Complete retention stores 5,397 observations by the end of generation, whereas Keepsake retains only 32. Despite this reduction, Keepsake lowers FVD from 734.2 to 476.6 (35.1%). The improvement over complete retention therefore extends to three-minute generation without increasing the memory budget. Visual examples in figure 4 shows camera revisits maintain consistency with our model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了十五条匹配的 180 秒 MemCam 轨迹，以测试在更长的生成时间范围内有界保留能力的表现，同时将内存预算固定为 B = 32 B=32。 图 3(a) 单独报告了这一评估结果，与 60 秒的测试组分开呈现。 完全保留策略在生成结束时存储了 5,397 个观察值，而 Keepsake 仅保留了 32 个。 尽管有所减少，Keepsake 仍将 FVD 从 734.2 降低至 476.6（降幅为 35.1%）。 因此，与完全保留策略相比的改进效果也延续到了三分钟长的生成过程中，且未增加内存预算。 图 4 中的视觉示例表明，摄像机的重复访问与我们模型的一致性得到了保持。

paragraphs.en: Under complete retention, the candidate pool grows continuously with generation. In MemCam, the mean unbounded candidate count increases from 671.9 in the first 45 seconds to 4,689.5 in the final 45 seconds of a 180-second rollout. In contrast, Keepsake caps the retained archive at 32 observations after each update while preserving the original retrieval interface and the amount of context supplied to the generator. paragraphs.en: Figure 3(b) shows that better viewpoint alignment does not necessarily imply more reliable historical evidence. Selected memories can match the query geometry while exhibiting greater visual drift, indicating that view relevance and memory fidelity are distinct. This distinction is important in long-horizon generation, because a geometrically suitable memory may still propagate degraded scene content. These results motivate evaluating not only which observations are stored, but also the fidelity of the evidence eventually retrieved from them.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3(b) 显示，更好的视角对齐并不一定意味着更可靠的历史证据。 选中的记忆可能与查询几何形状匹配，但表现出更大的视觉漂移，这表明视角相关性与记忆保真度是两个不同的概念。 这种区别在长期生成中非常重要，因为一个几何上合适的记忆仍可能传播退化的场景内容。 这些结果促使我们不仅要评估哪些观察结果被存储下来，还要评估最终从它们中检索出的证据的保真度。

paragraphs.en: We further decompose memory failure into two retrospective diagnostics: retention gap , measuring useful evidence lost through eviction, and selection gap , measuring the retriever’s shortfall relative to the best evidence still retained. Figure 3(c) shows full retention removes eviction loss but still exhibits the largest selection gap. In contrast, bounded policies trade a small amount of retention loss for a substantially smaller selection gap. This suggests that a compact archive can make useful evidence easier to retrieve, rather than simply reducing storage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将记忆失败进一步分解为两种回顾性诊断：保留差距，用于衡量因驱逐而丢失的有效证据；以及选择差距，用于衡量检索器相对于仍保留的最佳证据所存在的不足。 图 3(c) 显示，完全保留虽然消除了驱逐损失，但仍然存在最大的选择差距。 相比之下，受限策略以少量保留损失为代价，换取了显著更小的选择差距。 这表明，一个紧凑的存档可以使有效证据更容易被检索，而不仅仅是减少存储量。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Keepsake , a training-free controller that maintains fixed-capacity spatial memory by reassessing geometric and visual substitutability as new views arrive. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS over complete retention without changing the generator or retrieval rule. On fifteen matched 180-second MemCam trajectories, it reduces FVD by 35.1% while retaining 32 rather than 5,397 observations. Our diagnostics further distinguish evidence lost through eviction from retained evidence left unselected by retrieval, highlighting archive maintenance as a complement to retrieval. Together, these results demonstrate that selective retention can improve generation quality, not merely reduce storage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Keepsake，这是一种无需训练的控制器，通过在新视角到来时重新评估几何和视觉可替代性，来维持固定容量的空间记忆。 在 MemCam 和 WorldMem 中，Keepsake 在不改变生成器或检索规则的前提下，相较于完全保留策略提升了 FVD 和 LPIPS。 在十五条匹配的 180 秒 MemCam 轨迹上，它将 FVD 降低了 35.1%，同时仅保留 32 个观察结果，而非 5,397 个。 我们的诊断方法进一步区分了因驱逐而丢失的证据与因未被检索选中而保留的证据，凸显了档案维护作为检索补充的重要性。 综合来看，这些结果表明选择性保留能够提升生成质量，而不仅仅是减少存储量。

paragraphs.en: LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) compares generated frames with ground truth at corresponding trajectory indices, while FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) measures video-level distributional quality. Within each extended-rollout suite, policies are evaluated on the same video cohort with the same metric configuration.
paragraphs.zh: LPIPS（Zhang 等人，2018）将生成的帧与对应轨迹索引处的真实帧进行比较，而 FVD（Unterthiner 等人，2018）则衡量视频级别的分布质量。 对于两者而言，数值越低越好。 原生往返基准测试还报告了 PSNR 和 SSIM，这两个指标的值越高越好。 在每个扩展展开套件中，策略都在相同的视频数据集上，使用相同的指标配置进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The memory budget counts retained observations, rather than the context slots filled for an individual generation step. paragraphs.en: When the archive exceeds the budget, FIFO discards the oldest observations eligible for eviction until the capacity constraint is satisfied. Retention is therefore driven by recency rather than geometric or visual substitutability.

paragraphs.en: The retention-selection diagnostic separates two sources of shortfall relative to useful historical evidence. Retention gap measures evidence lost through eviction by comparing the best available full-history evidence with the best evidence still retained. Selection gap measures the retriever’s shortfall relative to the best retained evidence. The comparison uses target ground-truth features retrospectively; neither gap is an online retention objective.
paragraphs.zh: 保留-选择诊断方法区分了两种相对于有用历史证据的不足来源。 保留差距通过比较当前可用的最佳完整历史证据与仍被保留的最佳证据，来衡量因清除而丢失的证据。 选择差距衡量的是检索器相对于最佳保留证据的不足程度。 该比较以回顾性方式使用目标真实特征；这两种差距都不是在线保留目标。
